name: comp-229
title: Searchable Combobox Select
description: A labelled picker over sixteen frameworks, with a search field that filters as you type and a tick on the current choice. Picking a row closes the list and writes that name into the trigger.
use: When a picker holds too many options to scroll and people should type a few letters to find one.
avoid: The list is a fixed array of sixteen frameworks in the file, so a different set or remote results need edits.
a11y: The trigger is a labelled combobox and typing filters the rows, with arrow keys and enter working; the open animation ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a wide rounded trigger reading Select framework with a chevron. Opened, a dark panel with a search field on top covers the trigger and holds a tight column of framework names.
behaves: Clicking the trigger opens the panel; typing filters the rows on every keystroke, and choosing one closes the panel and updates the trigger. The clip types rea and settles on React.
customise: The framework list is an array in the file; replace it with your own names and values. The placeholder, the closed trigger text and the trigger width are set in the same file.
weight: light: Sixteen text rows in a popup with one short open animation.
demo: Select with search; frameworks Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt.js, Remix and others; typed rea to reach React
issues: The list stops after the ninth framework with no visible hint that more rows scroll below.
The open panel hides the trigger, so the saved choice is not visible while the list is open.
polishWhy: Clean rows and responsive search; plain styling and a list that hides its own scroll.
